"""Camera-guided joint controller for the single MakeLoadedPotato episode.
Only the public RCB client, camera calibration, depth, and proprioception are used.
"""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np, json, os, sys
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from PIL import Image
OUT='/app/output'
CAM=['robot0_agentview_center','robot0_agentview_left','robot0_agentview_right','robot0_eye_in_hand']
def fk(q):
    T=np.eye(4)
    aa=[0,0,0,.0825,-.0825,0,.088]
    dd=[.333,0,.316,0,.384,0,0]
    al=[0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2]
    for a,d,alpha,theta in zip(aa,dd,al,q):
        ca,sa,ct,st=np.cos(alpha),np.sin(alpha),np.cos(theta),np.sin(theta)
        T=T@np.array([[ct,-st,0,a],[st*ca,ct*ca,-sa,-d*sa],[st*sa,ct*sa,ca,d*ca],[0,0,0,1]])
    E=np.eye(4); E[:3,3]=[0,0,.2104]; E[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('z',-np.pi/4).as_matrix()
    return T@E
class Controller:
    def __init__(self):
        self.r=Robot(); self.o=self.r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none'); self.p=np.array(self.o.meta['proprio']['now']); self.q=self.p[4:11]; self.grip=self.p[36]
        self.cal=json.load(open(OUT+'/kin.json')) if os.path.exists(OUT+'/kin.json') else None
    def save(self,o,label):
        n=o.meta['control_steps']; path=f'{OUT}/runs/{n:06d}_{label}'; o.save(path)
        open(OUT+'/latest.txt','w').write(path)
        self.o=o; self.p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now']); self.q=self.p[4:11]; self.grip=self.p[36]
        print(path); print('q',self.q.round(5),'eef',self.p[26:29].round(5),'base',self.p[:4].round(5),'grip',self.p[11:13].round(5),'time',o.meta['time_left_s'])
    def obs(self,label='obs'):
        self.save(self.r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none'),label)
    def joint(self,q,sec=2,grip=None,base=None,torso=0,label='joint'):
        n=max(1,int(sec/.05)); A=np.zeros((n,13)); A[:,:7]=np.linspace(self.q,q,n); A[:,7]=self.grip if grip is None else grip; A[:,12]=-1
        if base is not None: A[:,8:11]=base; A[:,12]=1
        A[:,11]=torso
        o=self.r.submit('joint_position',A,cameras=CAM,video='none',include_depth=True,note=label)
        np.save(f'{OUT}/runs/actions_{o.meta["control_steps"]:06d}.npy',A)
        self.save(o,label)
    def world(self,q):
        T=fk(q); B=np.array(self.cal['B']); return B@T
    def ik(self,pos,R=None):
        q0=self.q.copy()
        def fun(q):
            T=self.world(q); e=list((T[:3,3]-pos)*4)
            if R is not None: e.extend(Rotation.from_matrix(R@T[:3,:3].T).as_rotvec())
            e.extend((q-q0)*.025)
            return e
        lo=np.array([-2.89,-1.76,-2.89,-3.06,-2.89,-.017,-2.89]); hi=np.array([2.89,1.76,2.89,-.07,2.89,3.75,2.89])
        sol=least_squares(fun,np.clip(q0,lo+.001,hi-.001),bounds=(lo,hi),max_nfev=500,ftol=1e-10,xtol=1e-10,gtol=1e-10)
        print('IK',sol.x.round(4),'target',pos,'pred',self.world(sol.x)[:3,3].round(4),'err',np.linalg.norm(self.world(sol.x)[:3,3]-pos))
        return sol.x
    def move(self,pos,sec=2,R=None,grip=None,label='move'):
        if R is None: R=self.world(self.q)[:3,:3]
        self.joint(self.ik(np.array(pos),R),sec,grip,label=label)
    def point(self,cam,u,v):
        d=self.o.depth[cam]; d=d[-1] if d.ndim==3 else d
        K=np.array(self.o.meta['cameras'][cam]['intrinsic_cv']); T=np.array(self.o.meta['cameras'][cam]['cam2world_gl'])
        z=float(d[int(v),int(u)]); p=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],-z,1]); print('point',u,v,z,(T@p)[:3]); return (T@p)[:3]
if __name__=='__main__':
    c=Controller()
    cmd=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'obs'
    if cmd=='obs': c.obs()
    elif cmd=='joint': c.joint(np.array(json.loads(sys.argv[2])),float(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 2,label='joint')
    elif cmd=='delta':
        q=c.q.copy(); q[int(sys.argv[2])]+=float(sys.argv[3]); c.joint(q,1,label='calib')
    elif cmd=='move':
        R=None if len(sys.argv)<4 else Rotation.from_euler('xyz',json.loads(sys.argv[3])).as_matrix()
        c.move(json.loads(sys.argv[2]),R=R,label='move')
    elif cmd=='point': c.point(CAM[int(sys.argv[2])],float(sys.argv[3]),float(sys.argv[4]))
    elif cmd=='grip': c.joint(c.q,1,grip=float(sys.argv[2]),label='grip')
    elif cmd=='base': c.joint(c.q,float(sys.argv[3]),base=json.loads(sys.argv[2]),label='base')
